title: A second hint on the Anki cards
text: after the Hint shows an example sentence, a second button shows the whole sentence in the other language, with the word you are practising left blank, so you can see what the other words in the example mean. In the decks since their update of 11 November.

title: A note on words with more than one card
text: a card's front now says when its spelling also has a card as another word class, such as “Also in this deck as: adverb, interjection”, after a reader found such cards hard to tell apart. In the decks since their update of 11 November.
